correctness.rationale: An exact identity from Jleli–Samet Theorem 1.3/Proposition 6.1 separates alpha^-2 from a uniformly C^2 series remainder. Pochhammer monotonicity bounds coefficients by C(k+1)^alpha, so the remainder and derivatives have uniform summable bounds for alpha<=1/2. Normalized Gamma ratios have uniform second derivatives; first derivatives yield exactly delta_n. Taylor with uniform remainder proves the sharp gap and joint limit. The trigamma sum and Gamma Taylor expansion give the fixed-n third-order coefficients. Finite numeric tests are nonproof cross-checks.
